subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: /r/ (red, rat, rod, rip); segmenting and blending; differentiates r and n

show.line: Listen. r, r, red. r, r, rat! Red starts with r.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with r, as in red?
Say the sound with me. r, as in run!
Is it r or n? Listen. Rod.
Listen. r, i, p. What word is it?
Does it start with r or n? Sort the pictures.

hints: Growl like a dog. r, r, r.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with r.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Nut starts with n. Rat starts with r.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. r, r, rat. Rat starts with r!

parent_line: Can hear the r sound and blend words like rat, red and rip.
